expectedText: I would like to prepare a document for my local club. First, I connect my device to a wireless network and open a browser. Then I visit the club website and use my own account. I type the notes with the keyboard and save a file in a folder. Before I upload the document, I check the date and the place. After I upload it, I look for the correct file name online. If the internet is unavailable, my offline copy still opens. I do not share my password in an email. When I finish, I use the logout button so that the next person cannot use my account.
